options.name: acct_interim_interval
options.description: The interval in seconds which should elapse between interim-updates. Must be more than 60s and should not be less than 600s.

options.name: amount_of_time
options.description: The amount of time this entry is allowed (in minutes) within the configured time period.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: check_items_additional_options
options.description: Additional RADIUS check-item attributes for this entry. Each list entry becomes a separate attribute. For experts only.

options.name: description
options.description: A description for this entry.

options.name: expiration
options.description: The date when this account should expire. Required format: Mmm dd yyyy (e.g. Jan 01 2030).

options.name: framed_ip_address
options.description: Framed-IP-Address MUST be supported by NAS. If the OpenVPN server uses a subnet style Topology the RADIUS server MUST also send back an appropriate Framed-IP-Netmask value matching the VPN Tunnel Network.

options.name: framed_ip_netmask
options.description: Framed-IP-Netmask MUST be supported by NAS.

options.name: framed_ipv6_address
options.description: When the IPv6 prefix part is empty it uses Framed-IPv6-Address. When the prefix part is filled in, it uses Framed-IPv6-Prefix. Example: 2001:db8:abab::5 or 2001:db8:abab::/64

options.name: framed_ipv6_route
options.description: Framed-IPv6-Route must be supported by NAS. Required format: Prefix Gateway Metric(s) (e.g. 2001:db8:0:16::/64 2001:db8::16:a0:20ff:fe99:a998 1).

options.name: framed_route
options.description: Framed-Route must be supported by NAS. Required format: Subnet Gateway Metric(s) (e.g. 192.168.10.0/24 192.168.10.1 1).

options.name: login_time
options.description: The time when this entry should have access. Empty for no time restriction. Example: Wk0855-2305,Sa|Su2230-0230 (weekdays after 8:55 AM and before 11:05 PM | any time on Saturday | Sunday after 10:30 PM and before 02:30 AM).

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: max_bandwidth_down
options.description: The maximum bandwidth for download in kilobits (1000 bits) per second (Kbit/s).

options.name: max_bandwidth_up
options.description: The maximum bandwidth for upload in kilobits (1000 bits) per second (Kbit/s).

options.name: max_total_octets
options.description: The amount of download and upload traffic (summarized) in megabytes (MB) for this entry. If using captive portal without periodic reauthentication enabled, this value must not exceed 4095 due to protocol limitations.

options.name: max_total_octets_time_range
options.description: The time period for the amount of download and upload traffic. This does not automatically reset the counter; you must configure a cronjob to reset it.

options.name: motp_authmethod
options.description: The authentication method for the Mobile One-Time Password (MOTP).

options.name: motp_enable
options.description: Enable or disable the use of Mobile One-Time Password (MOTP) for this user.

options.name: motp_offset
options.description: The timezone offset for this user.

options.name: motp_pin
options.description: The PIN for the Mobile One-Time Password (MOTP). It must be exactly 4 digits.

options.name: motp_secret
options.description: The secret for the Mobile One-Time Password (MOTP).

options.name: password
options.description: The password for this username.

options.name: password_encryption
options.description: The encryption method for the password.

options.name: point_of_time
options.description: The time period after which the 'Amount of Time' is reset.

options.name: reply_items_additional_options
options.description: Additional RADIUS reply-item attributes for this entry. Each list entry becomes a separate attribute. For experts only.

options.name: session_timeout
options.description: The time this entry has until relogin (in seconds).

options.name: simultaneous_connect
options.description: The maximum number of simultaneous connections with this entry. Leave null for no limit. If using FreeRADIUS with Captive Portal you should leave this null.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: top_additional_options
options.description: Additional RADIUS attributes placed at the TOP of this entry. Each list entry becomes a separate line. For experts only.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for this user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: The VLAN ID (integer from 1-4095) or the VLAN name that this entry should be assigned to. Must be supported by the NAS.

options.name: wispr_redirection_url
options.description: The URL the user should be redirected to after successful login. Example: http://www.google.com
